method: Per Decision 64 (SD-28 decisions.md, adopted SD-30 decisions.md Decision 34): for each class, enumerate its own archetype-table 'replaced slot' ids declared in the PCGen corpus (PREFACT/TYPE. token lists on that class's own *_Archetype_* archetype records), then grep src/rules_core/pilot_compute.rs for a real, unconditional (level-gated only) base computation of each slot's real id. wired_able is a count of slot ids with direct grep evidence of a computing function/const in pilot_compute.rs, never inferred from a near-miss name. named is the raw distinct slot-id count found in the class's own book-of-origin corpus file (via $PCGEN_CORPUS_ROOT), before any tier-collapse analysis, UNLESS collapsed_named is present (only computed where explicitly stated below). All commands are re-runnable against $PCGEN_CORPUS_ROOT (pinned oracle 7f818006e371188e5717fd18d74d18a420747fc6) and src/rules_core/pilot_compute.rs at this cycle's HEAD.
